latestVersion.changelog:
Auto-Updater (Gateway Cron) v1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Implements daily scheduled auto-updates for ClawHub skills at 04:00 (Asia/Shanghai timezone)
- Sends skill update summary reports with before/after version comparison to Feishu or Telegram
- Excludes Clawdbot self-update; updates skills only
- Provides simple cron job management and troubleshooting instructions
- Includes sample output and quick setup checklist
